create_batch_env: create a BatchEnv instance with a batch size and environment builder function
reset_batch_env: reset all environments in the batch and return stacked observations and rewards
step_batch_env: step all environments in parallel with a list of actions and return observations and rewards
get_observation_shape: get the observation shape per environment without the batch dimension
get_last_phase_rewards: get the last phase reward from each environment in the batch
